rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to strengthen and continue the operations of the National Food Authority (NFA) through the following measures: 1. provide a clean bill of health through mechanisms that transfer liabilities to a Board of Liquidators created which shall handle the disposition and liquidation of its assets; 2. the provision of initial capitalization which shall be provided by law (GAA);  3. The government through the Department of Budget Management shall include in the President´s budget proposal funds to be utilized for personal services, interests and other maintenance and operating expenses to maintain its function at ensuring its buffer stock of rice; 4. Provide for the necessary structural changes as a result of delimiting its functions to the maintenance of the country´s buffer stock of rice.
rows.status: Scheduled for meeting/hearing on 2014-11-24

committee_action.meethigh: The Technical Working Group was created , to be headed by Rep. Agapito Guanlao, to harmonize the bills and discuss related food security issues that need legislation.

As a result of the series of public hearings,particularly in Tuguegarao, Cagayan, General Santos City and Cebu City, the Joint Committee came up with a draft substitute bill which was presented to the Body for further deliberation. Amendments were introduced and the draft was thereby approved with all members present as co-authors. The Secretariat was directed to finalize the bill; send the final draft to the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCC), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance, (DoF), and relevant agencies for their comments and recommendations; and set a clarificatory meeting of the joint panel with the concerned agencies.

Position papers and recommendations from the concerned agencies, particularly the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCGs), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance (DoF) and other relevant agencies, were presented to the Body  for possible amendments to the draft substitute bill.

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SELECTION OF AN ACTING PRESIDENT AND ACTING VICE PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES IN CASE OF A FAILURE OF ELECTION
rows.abstract: Provides for the manner in which one who is to act as President shall be selected until a President or a Vice-President shall have qualified, in case of death, permanent disability, or the inability of the Senate President or the Speaker of the House of Representatives to take over as Acting President.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2015-05-19, transmitted to the Senate on 2015-05-21 and received by the Senate on 2015-05-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MECHANISM FOR THE NATIONAL IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FOR BENEFITS, RIGHTS AND CORRESPONDING OBLIGATIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to establish a National Identification Card System (NICS) which shall serve as a valid proof of identity of the person indicated on the card.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05060

rows.author: C403;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2014-12-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2014-12-17 and received by the Senate on 2014-12-17
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN REAL PROPERTY VALUATION IN THE PHILIPPINES, ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL VALUATION AUTHORITY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to promote the development and maintenance of a just, equitable, impartial and nationally consistent real property valuation based on internationally accepted valuation standards, concepts, principles and practices.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05288

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2014-08-05
committee_action.meethigh: Substitute Bill to House Bills Numbered 84, 490, 1060, 1797, 1968, 2368 and 2807 was approved without amendment.

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEBT MANAGEMENT BOARD, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares it a policy of the State to implement a sound and effective debt management system and strategies as an integral part of the country´s overall macroeconomic management and public administration.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THE GRANTING OF REWARDS AND PROTECTION TO THOSE WHO WILL REPORT MALFEASANCE IN GOVERNMENT OFFICES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Grants a reward or incentive to a government employee who report any act of malfeasance committed by his superior or any of his co-employees, in terms of cash, bonus or promotion in rank, if qualified, and shall be provided protection against any retaliation from erring officials or employees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REORGANIZE AND STRENGTHEN THE COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, REPEALING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6939, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CHARTER OF THE COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
rows.abstract: Seeks to make the Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) a proactive partner of the cooperative sector by strengthening its development and regulatory powers to ensure that the Authority will be more responsive to the challenges of the future.
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2014-03-11

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2014-03-11
committee_action.meethigh: Unnumbered Substitute Bill was approved with amendment.

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLES 155 AND 157 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209 AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, SO AS TO STRENGTHEN THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAW GOVERNING THE FAMILY HOME
rows.abstract: Amends certain provisions of the Family Code of the Philippines, among them the provision on the value of the real property and the high cost of adequate shelter, increasing the value attached to the family home to conform it with present day economic realities, if only to give full meaning to the spirit of the law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE TOLL REGULATORY BOARD TO CONDUCT PUBLIC HEARINGS PRIOR TO THE APPROVAL OF TOLL RATES OR ANY INCREASE THEREIN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED EIGHTEEN HUNDRED NINETY-FOUR
rows.abstract: Seeks to require the Toll Regulatory Board (TRB) to conduct public hearings prior to the approval of initial toll rates of any such infrastructure that may yet be constructed, or any proposal tom increase the toll rates of the existing ones.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING CIVIL SERVICE ELIGIBILITY TO CONTRACTUAL AND CO-TERMINOUS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WHO HAVE RENDERED A TOTAL OF FIVE (5) YEARS OF EFFICIENT SERVICE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants civil service eligibility to contractual or co-terminus government employees who have rendered a total of five (5) years of efficient service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2014-05-19, transmitted to the Senate on 2014-05-21 and received by the Senate on 2014-05-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-FOUR HUNDRED NINETY-TWO, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL MUSEUM ACT
rows.abstract: Authorizes the National Museum to use part of its income to augment the financial requirements of its operations.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04214

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE MEDICAL TOURISM BUREAU WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Establishes a bureau in the government whose task will be to properly and adequately address the needs of foreign tourists as well as Filipino balikbayans and overseas Filipino workers seeking medical treatment in the country, and of the private sector seeking to provide the services for those needs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TRAVEL ALLOWANCES TO BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7883, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'THE BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS' BENEFITS AND INCENTIVES ACT OF 1995,' AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant travel allowances to barangay health workers to aid in the fulfillment of their duties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2013-07-23

rows.author: C403;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FRANKING PRIVILEGES TO SANGGUNIANG BARANGAYS
rows.abstract: Grants exemption to Sangguniang Barangay from the payment of postage on any mail matter they send to government agencies and officials, both local and national, provided that his exemption will only be available to assist and expedite the conduct of the official businesses, activities and duties of the Sangguniang Barangays and will not be utilized for matters which are purely personal or politically partisan.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2013-07-23
